words.gloss_range: in it; a fronted locative predicate whose feminine suffix resumes the earth from 55:10
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) opens the ayah by putting the reader inside the already placed earth before any produce is named. The preposition is not a loose scene marker; it forms the fronted predicate of a verbless clause, so fruit and the palm are discovered as contents within that location. The bound feminine suffix keeps 55:10 grammatically active, making the earth a definite container rather than an unnamed place. The clause also changes the feel of the sequence: after the prior divine act of placing, provision now stands present in an agentless inventory. The same locative frame can naturally continue into the following produce line in 55:12, but here its main work is to organize the current list from container to contents.

words.prose: {{ar:فَٰكِهَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:fākihatun}}) is the first named content inside the earth-frame. Its nominative case makes it the delayed subject, not the object of the preposition, and its indefiniteness keeps the fruit category open rather than exhausted. The root field of {{ar:ف ك ه}} ({{tr:f-k-h}}) lets concrete fruit carry delight: this is edible provision, but not bare subsistence. The word then prepares a zoom, since the broad fruit category is followed by the definite palm as a known exemplar. Its recurrence with the palm in provision catalogues, including later in this surah at 55:68 and elsewhere at 23:19 and 80:31, makes the local pairing feel patterned rather than random. The sound link with the opening locative gives container and first content a light audible bond, but the main payoff remains grammatical and lexical: an open category of enjoyable provision is placed inside the earth.

Because the second item is explicitly linked, the list becomes cumulative rather than an apposition or a fresh clause. The particle also sets up a coordination habit that can be heard into 55:12, where further produce items continue the inventory. Its fused recitational flow into the following definite noun makes the joining audible, but the main payoff is syntactic: one letter extends the earth-frame and creates the zoom from category to exemplar.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّخْلُ}} ({{tr:al-nakhlu}}) narrows the inventory from fruit in general to the familiar palm-kind. Its article and collective shape present a known class rather than one counted tree, and its nominative coordination keeps it inside the same earth-frame. The following qualifier attaches to this collective palm, so the tree is immediately viewed through its covered productive structure rather than merely named. The root {{ar:ن خ ل}} ({{tr:n-kh-l}}) has supplied sifting and refining branches, but the local Quranic distribution and produce setting keep the palm tree as the selected sense; the refining image can only color the tree as a natural processor, not replace it. Inter-ayah comparisons sharpen the choice: 50:10 qualifies palms by height and clusters, while 55:11 moves toward sheaths; 55:68 later returns to the fruit-palm pairing in a garden scene. The doubled nasal of the definite form gives the named tree audible density after the lighter fruit noun.

words.gloss_range: possessing; a feminine nominative construct qualifier that defines the palm by its sheaths
words.root_gloss_range: possessor or one characterized by an attached noun is selected; demonstrative, relative, interrogative, and later technical essence branches are not local senses
words.prose: {{ar:ذَاتُ}} ({{tr:dhātu}}) turns the palm from a named tree into a tree characterized by what it possesses. Its construct state governs the following genitive complement, and the definite complement makes the whole qualifier definite enough to bind a recognized attribute-class to the palm. Its feminine nominative form agrees with the collective palm, so the sheath phrase modifies that palm rather than adding a third provision item. The root {{ar:ذ و و}} ({{tr:dh-w-w}}) selects the possessor or characterized-by branch here; later technical essence language is only a narrowed undertone, because the local botanical phrase makes possession concrete. The payoff is that the sheaths are not incidental accessories: through this formula they become constitutive of how the palm is described. Similar attribute formulas define entities by signature features elsewhere, including 51:7, 54:13, 85:1, and 89:7, and the same surah continues this possessed-attribute pattern in 55:12. The same relational root can mark divine grace in 2:251 and human fortune in 28:79, while here it marks the earth's botanical bounty.

words.gloss_range: the sheaths; a definite genitive broken plural naming the palm's protective botanical coverings
words.root_gloss_range: plant envelope, fruit sheath, sleeve-like covering, muzzle, sealing, suppressing, and compact covering fields; local sense selects botanical palm sheaths with enclosure coloring
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَكْمَامِ}} ({{tr:al-akmāmi}}) is the ayah's landing word. Grammatically it is the genitive complement governed by the preceding construct, so the sheaths are bound to the palm as its possessed and defining feature. The article and broken plural name a recognizable class of coverings, not a random set, and the plural coverings define one collective palm-kind through layered botanical packaging. The root {{ar:ك م م}} ({{tr:k-m-m}}) selects the plant-sheath branch here, while sleeve, muzzle, and sealing branches sharpen the shared topology of enclosure without replacing the botanical sense. The word is rare and concentrated: its only other supplied Quranic occurrence is 41:47, where sheaths belong to a hidden-to-emergent fruit context. At the close of 55:11, the sequence has moved from fruit to palm to sheath, and from the earth as container to a smaller enclosure within the palm. That concrete inventory realizes the placed-earth purpose from 55:10 and prepares the next plant-attribute detail in 55:12. The repeated closing m-sound fits that final image of protected, concealed yield.

strongest_changes: The sheaths became temporal operators: protection now, emergence and harvest later.
Judgment and recompense branches activated a crop-processing chain of ripening, cutting, baskets, sifting, selection, and return.
Exact later returns of fruit and palm unfolded 55:11 as a compressed precursor without canceling its terrestrial reading.

summary.what_was_special: The three focus roots activated unusually dense but distinct networks around enclosure, disclosure, gestation, productive boundaries, selection, and harvest. The literal fruit, palm, and sheath reading remains live underneath every extension rather than being replaced by a single synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the gestational and harvest chains are inter-ayah mechanisms or productive coincidences of branch polysemy.
Whether the later gardens make 55:11 genuinely proleptic or simply repeat a shared abundance lexicon.
How much weight to give form-distant mappings and branches such as ج ز ي to ج ز ز, و ك ء as a tied vessel, and ق ص ر as a date basket.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Pleasure held inside protection.** `ف ك ه/B002` gives pleasant fruit, while `ك م م/B002` gives the plant sheath protecting fruit and buds. Their coordination supplies produce plus enclosure; I infer that enjoyment depends on a prior hidden phase of protection. The ayah reads as staged provision, not instant display.
2. **Fruit as affective ease.** `ف ك ه/B001` (pleasant ease and delighted enjoyment) is activated by later garden scenes. I infer a shift from object to recipient-state: the fruit is part of a mechanism producing settled delight. This reading remains distinct from the botanical sheath mechanism.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:54 reveals luxurious inner linings and near fruit. That later inside/outside arrangement mirrors the sheaths here and makes protected inwardness a recurring condition of accessible abundance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **`ك م م` `B002` — “plant sheath protecting fruit,” with `ف ك ه` `B002` — “fruit” and `ن خ ل` `B001` — “palm.”** Structural cue: the locative `فِيهَا` develops the earth-for-creatures clause, and the palm is characterized by sheaths before grain and chaff appear in 55:12. Assigned role: sheathing introduces protection and latency inside the provision system. Packet evidence is the nominal catalogue and the branch’s explicit plant scope. Inference: nourishment depends on concealed maturation before availability. Reading change: the ayah shows provision as a guarded process, not only an inventory of finished goods.

facets.statement: Çekirdek gönderim, hurma veren ağaç türüdür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel örtme çekirdeğini, bir kabın ağzını bağlayıp çamurla sıvayarak kapatmayı ve tanıklığı bastırıp gizlemeyi açıkça aynı dal içinde verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal eylem olarak örtme, ağzı sıkıca kapatma ve açıklanması gereken şeyi bastırma ile sınırlıdır; özel giysi, bitki kılıfı ve hayvan ağızlığı adlarını doğrudan içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel örtme eylemini korur, ancak kap ağzını bağlayıp sıvama ve tanıklığı bastırma anlamlarını yalnızca kendi belirli yapılarında gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üstünü bir örtü ya da tabakayla kapatmaktır; bir kabın ağzını bağlayıp çamurla sıvayarak sıkıca kapatmak bunun özel bir uygulamasıdır. Açıklanması gereken bir tanıklığı bastırıp gizlemek de bu fiziksel çekirdeğin soyut uzantısıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin üstünü örterek görünmesini veya açıkta kalmasını engellemektir.
Bir kabın ağzını bağlayıp çamurla sıvayarak sıkıca kapatmaktır.
Bir tanıklığı ortaya konmasını engelleyecek biçimde bastırıp gizlemektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ve kapatma çekirdeğinde birleşir; nesnenin üstünü kapatma, kabın ağzını bağlayıp sıvama ve tanıklığın açıklanmasını bastırma bu çekirdeğin fiziksel ve soyut gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.text: örtmek, sıkıca kapatmak veya bastırıp gizlemek

error_profile.preserves: Nesnenin üstünü kapatan genel fiziksel eylemi eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kap veya tulum ağzının bağlanıp çamurla kapatıldığı özel bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın ağzını hem bağlama hem de çamurla sıvayarak kapatma aşamalarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir tanıklığın açıklanmasını engelleyip onu saklama bağlamında kullanılır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد يدل على غشاء وغطاء (maqayis)؛ وكممت الشيء طينته (ayn)؛ وكممت الشيء: غطيته، وكممت الحب إذا شددت رأسه (sihah)؛ الكمة: كل ظرف غطيت به شيئا، وكممت رأس الدن أي سددته وطينته، وقيل كمت أي غطيت، والكم: قمع الشيء وستره، ومنه كميت الشهادة إذا قمعتها وسترتها (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı belirli biçimi yan yana getirir: bir varlığın sıkı ve toplu yapılı olması ile insanların bir araya gelmesi. Dal bu ortak toplanmışlık bağıyla kullanılabilir, ancak ikisini tek ve sınırsız bir genel kök anlamı gibi sunmamak gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca sıkı ve toplu beden yapısı ile insanların bir araya gelmesi kullanımlarını kapsar; fiziksel örtme ve bilinç yitimi bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, sıkı yapılı olma ile insanların toplanmasını iki ayrı sözlükselleşmiş kullanım olarak gösterir ve bunları genel bir çıplak kök anlamında birleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Dağınık olmayan toplanmışlık fikri iki ayrı belirli kullanımda görülür: beden bölümlerinin sıkı ve toplu bir yapı oluşturması ile insanların bir araya gelmesi. Bu ikisi, sınırsız bir genel anlam değil, belirli biçimlerin anlamlarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin veya canlının sıkı, toplu ve derli bir beden yapısına sahip olmasıdır.
Bir insan topluluğunun aynı yerde bir araya gelip toplanmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplanmışlık iki ayrı belirli biçimde aktarılır: sıkı ve derli beden yapısı ile insanların bir araya gelmesi. Kaynaklara özgü ayrı claimler bulunmadığından bu ayrım ortak açıklamada tutulur.

concept_gloss.text: sıkı yapılı olma veya bir araya toplanma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın iki belirli kullanımını ortak toplanmışlık bağıyla gösterir; bunları her bağlama yayılan tek bir anlam saymaz.

error_profile.preserves: Sıkı beden yapısı ile insanların toplanması arasındaki ayrımı ve ortak bağı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya canlının beden yapısının sıkı ve derli oluşu anlatıldığında kullanılır.
